_comment: Resolved primary sources for the fifteen techniques The Prompt Report lists that
the catalog lacks. This file is the output of a search, not a set of records: the
hard part of writing a technique record is establishing its citation, and that is
done here so the authoring step is mechanical.
Every entry was resolved against arXiv's own metadata by exact title query and
matched at Jaccard 1.00 — an exact title match, not a similarity guess. Author
lists and venue comments are recorded as arXiv states them; where arXiv states no
venue, `venue` says 'arXiv preprint' rather than inferring one from the survey's
citation key. That inference is how eight wrong titles entered the frozen catalog.
Fifteen gap techniques resolve to thirteen distinct papers: three papers each cover
a parent/child pair in the survey's taxonomy, and AutoDiCoT has no external source
because it originates in The Prompt Report's own case study.
prompt-mining shares arXiv 1911.12543 with the already-present prompt-paraphrasing
record. That is correct — the survey cites one paper for both techniques — and
check:citations permits a shared id provided the titles agree.
Nothing here is a catalog record yet. Adding them is the follow-on, and each will
need the same treatment the ensembling eight got: a description written from the
paper's abstract, source_audit.description of verified-against-abstract, and
pitfalls left unverified until the papers are read.
